data.name: UNLOVED
data.detailed_description:
UNLOVED is based on the community award-winning mod for Doom2 with the same name by the same creator. UNLOVED is a strange place. A twisted reality. A nightmare that comes to life. A place where demons and abhorrent monsters manifest and possess the living with only one goal: to end you. Nothing wants you here. And there is no way out. Only the elevator that leads further and further down into the darkness of your insanity.

Play alone or in a group of up to 4 players and explore the endless amount of basement levels that are procedurally arranged every time you enter. Work as a team, open new areas, find weapon-mods, solve personal challenges, complete level objectives and unlock new skills to survive this trip into the unknown.

Main Features

Fast Paced Shooter Gameplay + Coop Features
The game resurrects the old-school fast paced action shooter gameplay. Combined with deadly monsters and modern coop-features that encourage playing in a team to stay alive in a harsh and deadly environment. Find and join other players online or play via LAN. If you don't feel like playing in a team, you can play alone just as well.

Punishment System
Everything you do in this game has consequences. The more you take, the more the evil grows. Greed and too much curiosity will increase your punishment until you get completely overwhelmed by an endless tide of monstrosities.

Randomly arranged Levels
Every basement area is generated from hand crafted level chunks that are randomly arranged. After that, certain areas get locked by the “Architect” and you have to find certain key items to access them. Every level has final rooms with objectives the player has to complete in order to leave the level.

Create your own unique Play-Style
Besides customizing your appearance, you can also create your own unique play-style. Equip magic trinkets with unearthly powers that can completely change the way you experience the game. Want to become super tough, or do you prefer to run super fast? Do you want to deal lots of damage, or have the highest chances of survival? The right combination of trinkets makes it possible and sets you apart from other players.

Play in 4 different Game Modes
If you want a different experience besides the Ultra Violence, you can also select alternative Game Modes that may suit your style a bit more. Classic Horror gets your blood pumping while you are desperately looking for enough ammunition to survive the next enemy. Arcade Style increases the already fast paced action to the max, giving you the ultimate killing frenzy experience. And then there is the HOT Mode - the most innovative game mode in years...

Find Weapon-Mods to be more efficient
Every weapon can be upgraded with special mods. These can alter the way a weapon functions in dramatic ways. They may change the way the weapon operates, increase fire rate or give boosts like speed reloading.

Gain Karma by completing personal Challenges
You don’t just get experience points for killing monsters. Each time you play, certain challenges are given to you. If you fulfill your personal objectives, you get Karma points that you can spend to upgrade your Persona.

Unlock new Items and the Mysteries that UNLOVED holds
Within the levels are different mysterious objects scattered. By collecting them, you can later unlock new player colors, ranks, trinkets and pieces of information that may or may not have clues about this unearthly realm of insanity.

data.short_description: Based on the community award-winning Doom2 mod with the same name by the same creator, UNLOVED is reimagined in the Unreal Engine 4 to bring forth the unspeakable terror in new ways. Play coop with your friends, increase your skills, mod your weapons and face the horror that this unearthly place holds...

reviews.review:
A brutal, chaotic FPS that deserves more love. 🔥💀

UNLOVED is the kind of game that feels like it was made by people who genuinely understand what makes old-school FPS games so addictive.

It's fast, violent, dark, and absolutely packed with enemies.

There are no long conversations, endless cutscenes, or complicated distractions getting in the way. You load into a nightmare, grab your weapons, and start blasting your way through hordes of demons and other horrible creatures.

And honestly?

It's fantastic.

🔫 Old-school FPS action done right

The combat is the biggest reason to play UNLOVED.

It's fast, responsive, and incredibly satisfying. You're constantly moving, shooting, dodging, reloading, and trying not to get surrounded.

The enemies come at you aggressively, which means standing still is usually a very bad idea.

You need to keep moving.

You need to watch your surroundings.

And you need to make those weapons count.

There's something incredibly satisfying about clearing a room after being completely overwhelmed moments earlier.

💀 The atmosphere is DARK

UNLOVED does a great job creating a creepy, oppressive atmosphere.

The environments feel like places you absolutely should not be visiting, and the combination of darkness, monsters, sound effects, and brutal combat creates a constant feeling of danger.

It's not necessarily trying to scare you with cheap jump scares every five seconds.

Instead, it creates that feeling of:

"Something horrible is probably around that corner."

And then you turn the corner and discover that, yes, something horrible is definitely there. 😂

👹 The enemies keep you moving

The enemy variety helps keep the combat interesting.

Different enemies require different approaches, and once multiple types start appearing together, encounters can become seriously chaotic.

You can't just focus on one target forever because something else is probably already trying to tear your face off.

This makes movement and positioning incredibly important.

You aren't just shooting enemies.

You're constantly trying to survive the situation.

💥 Weapons feel great

The arsenal is exactly what you'd want from a game like this.

Weapons have satisfying impact, and there's something incredibly enjoyable about switching between them depending on what's trying to kill you.

There's no shortage of opportunities to unload ridiculous amounts of ammunition into horrifying creatures.

And that's basically therapy, right?

🔪 The co-op is even better

Playing UNLOVED with friends takes the chaos to another level.

Everything becomes more intense when you're trying to survive together, especially when the enemies start coming from every direction.

You get those classic co-op moments where everything is going perfectly...

...until suddenly everyone is screaming, running in different directions, and desperately trying to survive.

Then somebody goes down.

Then somebody tries to save them.

Then everybody dies.

And somehow you immediately start another run.

That's the magic of co-op shooters.

🎮 Simple concept, addictive gameplay

What I appreciate most about UNLOVED is how focused it is.

The game understands that sometimes you don't need a giant open world or a hundred complicated mechanics.

Sometimes you just need:

Guns + monsters + ammunition + friends = fun.

And UNLOVED delivers exactly that.

The progression and replayability also give you plenty of reasons to keep coming back. There's always another run, another weapon to experiment with, another challenge to overcome, or another friend to drag into the nightmare.

🔥 The perfect kind of chaotic

UNLOVED feels like a love letter to classic FPS games while still having its own personality.

It's dark, violent, fast-paced, and unapologetically focused on gameplay.

If you enjoy games where you're constantly surrounded by enemies and the only reasonable response is to grab the biggest gun available and start firing, you're going to have a great time.

🏆 Final verdict

UNLOVED is an incredibly fun old-school FPS that combines fast combat, brutal enemies, dark atmosphere, satisfying weapons, and excellent co-op chaos.

It's challenging without feeling like the challenge exists just to annoy you, and the gameplay loop is extremely easy to get addicted to.

If you enjoy classic shooters, demon-slaying, horde combat, or co-op FPS games, this is absolutely worth playing.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Highly Recommended!

Bring your friends.

Bring your weapons.

Bring a LOT of ammunition.

Because whatever is waiting in the darkness...

It definitely doesn't love you. 💀🔫🔥


I hope this review has been helpful.

Mínimos:
  • Sistema Operativo *: Windows 10, Windows 8, Windows 7 32-bit
  • Processador: Quad-core Intel or AMD processor, 2.5 GHz or faster
  • Memória: 4 GB de RAM
  • Placa gráfica: NVIDIA GeForce 470 GTX / AMD Radeon 6870 HD or higher
  • DirectX: Versão 11
  • Espaço no disco: Requer 3 GB de espaço livre
  • Placa de som: Windows compatible

Recomendados:
  • Sistema Operativo *: Windows 10, Windows 8, Windows 7 32-bit
  • Processador: Quad-core Intel or AMD processor, 3 GHz or faster
  • Memória: 8 GB de RAM
  • Placa gráfica: NVIDIA Geforce GTX 660 / AMD Radeon HD 7870 or higher
  • DirectX: Versão 11
  • Rede: Ligação à Internet de banda larga
  • Espaço no disco: Requer 3 GB de espaço livre
  • Placa de som: Windows compatible
